<b>Skynx</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] who appears only in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They replace [[Styx]] in this mode, and provide [[Rosaries]] in exchange for [[Silkeater]]s.

== In-game Events ==
Hornet encounters Skynx behind a breakable wall east of Styx's original [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]], in the easternmost room of [[Sinner's Road]]. They are originally shrouded by darkness, but emerge when Hornet notices them.

They request Silkeaters from Hornet, providing {{R|46–154}} in exchange.<ref group="Note">Skynx gives either {{R|50}}, {{R|100}}, or {{R|150}}, with a variation of up to {{R|4}}.</ref>

Skynx is found behind a breakable wall next to the bench in the easternmost room in [[Sinner's Road]].

== Trivia ==
* Though Skynx has no [[Needolin]] dialogue, they do 'sing' along with it. The audio files used for it are a combination of [[Muckroach]] singing and the sound of [[Pendragor]] wings.
** [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Text|Cut Needolin dialogue]] for Skynx exists in the game's files:
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* I shall not be?...
* No more me?...
* Sweet little thingssss...
* To feed... To swell...
* To cleanssse...
}}
* If Hornet rams into the wall near their lair's door using [[Swift Step]] or hits the wall near them with the [[Needle]], Skynx roars in response. The same audio is also used for a [[Marrowmaw]]'s roar.
* Skynx appears to possibly be mimicking [[Styx]]'s final words as a part of their declining Silkeater dialogue: <i>"Ssssomeone, ssssave me"</i>. This includes Styx's drawn-out S sounds, in contrast to the lines copied from Hornet which pronounce the letter S normally.
** In the Japanese translation of the game, Styx has a different speech quirk more akin to stuttering, and also does not use <i>kanji</i>. Skynx copies both of these behaviours, futher lending credence to this theory.
* Skynx's mask is most likely Styx's stolen mask upside-down.
